description.value: An RV-oriented camp in suburban Surrey near Tynehead Regional Park, convenient for riders navigating Metro Vancouver but offering little in the way of natural setting or cyclist-specific amenities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website tynehead.com has been hijacked by an Indonesian gambling/e-commerce site (MEGAWIN288) and contains no usable information about the RV camp; all amenity data must rely solely on OSM tags. OSM confirms a fee-based caravan site with power supply, sanitary dump station, and tent camping permitted, but no cyclist-specific amenities can be confirmed. The domain squatting means the website cannot be used to corroborate contact details or operating status.
concerns: Website domain tynehead.com has been hijacked/domain-squatted by an unrelated Indonesian gambling and e-commerce site (MEGAWIN288); no usable business information can be obtained from it.
Cannot confirm current operating status, amenities, or any contact details without a working website.
OSM power_supply=yes likely refers to RV electrical hookups; device or e-bike charging for cyclists cannot be inferred without further evidence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The campground appears real per OSM and permits tent camping, but the website domain has been hijacked by an unrelated site, making it impossible to verify current operating status, amenities, or contact details. Manual verification is needed before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Manual outreach via the listed phone number (+1-604-589-1161) is recommended to confirm the business is still operating and to gather cyclist-relevant amenity details before including in the directory.
